summary: A local-first, open-source platform for building custom AI agents, RAG pipelines, and multimodal workflows with full data ownership.
usecases: Private company chat assistant trained on internal documentation
Custom AI agent for task automation without external API costs
Multimodal RAG processing both images and text locally
ideas: Deploy as a local alternative to ChatGPT for teams handling sensitive data
Integrate with voice assistants for hands-free AI interaction in smart homes
Build a multi-agent collaboration system for complex project execution
